units.english: The Veusade bristles with gun ports but has a small overall weapons capacity; in fact, it is just enough to saturate its hardpoints with drag cannons. Such a narrowly-focused design makes these ships ill-suited for multipurpose use, but they are frequently seen as auxiliary or police craft, owing to their ability to rapidly catch and immobilize fleeing vessels.

units.english: Navigating the stars with the grace of a flitting bird, the compact Vujlet is a mass-produced High Houses warship flexible enough to serve in a variety of light-duty roles. Large enough to operate as a self-sufficient unit, these vessels serve as a useful bridge between short-ranged and relatively vulnerable interceptors, and larger, more resource-intensive warships that can be much more expensive to build and operate.

units.english: The design was originally employed by House Kaatrij as a stealth reconnaissance vessel that made use of their then-recently-developed cloaking technology. As the alliance between the New Houses strengthened, the plans for the Vujlet were distributed among them, and the light warship rapidly became a mainstay of their fleets. Unfortunately, without the materials present in their Predecessors' domain, House Kaatrij has been unable to manufacture stealth equipment for the Vujlet in the modern era.

units.english: The first prototype cloaks produced by the old House Kaatrij nearly eighteen hundred years ago were far from the adaptable and reliable technology they are today, each one consuming the power output of a large fusion reactor. Only once the House's engineers started to incorporate a ship's shielding into the cloak's operation was it made truly practical; hence, even today, the efficient cloak of the Vujlet-Usaqri relies on a steady stream of shield energy to operate. As a result, this modified variant of the Vujlet features a higher-capacity shield grid and more crew to maintain it.

units.english: The Vujlet-Usaqri's cloaking technology is integrated with its hull and cannot be removed. Optimized for general use, it draws a moderate amount of fuel and shields while active.
